name: Are there different pricing structures or commission rates for the 'List With a Twist Program'?

mainEntity.name: Are there different pricing structures or commission rates for the 'List With a Twist Program'?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the 'List With a Twist Program' typically offers different pricing structures and commission rates compared to a standard listing, which is one of its core benefits. The specific cost will depend on the level of service and marketing support you select. For example, if you opt for a more hands-on approach as a seller, you might qualify for a reduced commission. A key practical tradeoff is that while a lower commission might seem appealing, it could mean taking on more tasks yourself or choosing fewer marketing services. We provide transparent details on all available structures during your consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The 'List With a Twist Program' offers varying pricing and commission rates based on selected services and marketing support.
